### About Formalize

[Formalize](https://seedtable.com/companies/formalize)

[Copenhagen](https://seedtable.com/best-startups-in-copenhagen), [Denmark](https://seedtable.com/best-startups-in-denmark)[Compliance](https://seedtable.com/best-legaltech-startups)236 employeesFounded 202156.4M USD total raised [Website](https://formalize.com/)

Formalize is a compliance operations platform, founded in 2021. It has raised $56.4M across 3 funding rounds, most recently a $35M Series B in October 2025, from investors including Acton Capital Partners, BlackFin Capital Partners and Blackfin Tech Fund.

### About This Round

Formalize, a rapidly growing European legaltech company specializing in compliance software, has announced the closing of a €30 million Series B funding round. The investment was co-led by the German venture capital firm [Acton Capital](https://seedtable.com/companies/acton-capital-partners) and [BlackFin Tech](https://seedtable.com/investors/blackfin-tech-fund), the venture arm of the French firm BlackFin Capital Partners. The round also saw participation from UK-based [West Hill Capital](https://seedtable.com/companies/west-hill-capital) and Canada’s [CIBC Innovation Banking](https://seedtable.com/investors/cibc-investment-banking). This new capital injection, which follows a previous round in 2024, brings the company’s total funding to €50 million. The funds are designated to consolidate Formalize’s position as a leading European platform for governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) activities and to fuel its expansion into key markets, including the DACH region and France, through the opening of new offices and the growth of local teams.[1](https://formalize.com/en/formalize-raises-30-million)

Founded in 2021 in Aarhus, Denmark, by Magnus Boye, Kristoffer Abell, and Jakob Lilholm, Formalize develops SaaS solutions designed to simplify corporate compliance management. The company offers an integrated platform that automates and streamlines regulatory compliance processes across various domains, such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and whistleblowing. The solution addresses a pressing need for businesses and SMEs across Europe, which are contending with an increasingly complex and demanding regulatory landscape. New requirements related to data protection, cybersecurity, and reporting—including GDPR, NIS2, and DORA—have fundamentally changed how organizations must manage information security and cyber resilience. Formalize’s platform provides a unified environment to automate compliance workflows, consolidate requirements, and help companies proactively adapt to regulatory changes.[1](https://formalize.com/en/formalize-raises-30-million)

Since its inception and following the momentum from its Series A round in 2024, Formalize has seen significant growth. The platform is now used by over 8,000 enterprises and SMEs, as well as more than 850 consulting firms and law firms. The company has established offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Madrid, and Milan, and employs over 160 people. Its presence in Italy has been particularly successful; after opening a branch in Milan in 2024, the company has nearly tripled its revenue in the country, expanded its customer base by over two-thirds, and doubled its ecosystem of partners. In Italy, Formalize’s solutions are used by more than 1,200 companies, including prominent names like La Feltrinelli, Ibl Banca, Cassa Lombarda, the Municipality of Novara, and Burger King.[1](https://formalize.com/en/formalize-raises-30-million)

Jakob Lilholm, CEO of Formalize, stated, “Compliance is no longer optional: it has become essential to doing business. At Formalize, we are building a future where automation and AI simplify governance, risk, and compliance activities for European SMEs without ever compromising on security and local expertise.” Christian Jessen, the company's CFO, added that the funding round “reflects the strong momentum Formalize has built in Europe and investors’ confidence in our ability to execute.”[1](https://formalize.com/en/formalize-raises-30-million)

Investors also expressed strong confidence in the company’s trajectory. “It’s increasingly difficult for small and medium-sized businesses in the EU to manage all the regulatory requirements. Formalize impressed us with a superior solution,” commented Fritz Oidtmann, managing partner at Acton Capital. Michele Foradori, managing director of BlackFin Tech, noted, “At BlackFin, we’re increasingly convinced that Formalize has assembled the right product and team to become the compliance benchmark for European SMEs, transforming GDPR, NIS2, and DORA into simple and scalable processes.”[1](https://formalize.com/en/formalize-raises-30-million)
